The '''RK-5 Starforged blaster''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was a similar model to the [[RK-4 Starforged blaster]].

==Behind the scenes==
The RK-5 Starforged blaster was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Acolyte's Shadow Pack.
